generation.explanation: The graph of y = tan(x) repeats every π and has vertical asymptotes wherever cos(x) = 0, because tan(x) = sin(x)/cos(x). From −2π to 2π, these occur at x = −3π/2, −π/2, π/2, and 3π/2. As x approaches any asymptote, tan(x) tends to +∞ from the left and −∞ from the right; the function is undefined on the asymptote itself.
